QuestInfo.name: Asking After Alex, the Town Resident
QuestInfo.0: It looks like #p425#, the City Clerk, is looking for someone to help with her work. Let's go check out #p431# in front of #m10003007#.
QuestInfo.1: #p425#, the City Clerk, asked me to check on #b#p402##k, a resident of the city. Let's go see how #p402# is doing. \r\n#rOnly characters at Level 12 or higher can complete this quest.#k
QuestInfo.2: I checked on #p402#, a resident of #m10003000#. In a city like this, no news is the best news.

0.0: "I'm curious to know how #p402#, one of our residents in #m10003000#, is doing lately. And hey, don't get the wrong idea—I'm absolutely NOT asking because I'm wondering when he's finally heading back home or anything. Anyway, I'd appreciate it if you could go check on him for me.\r\n- #p425#"

1.0: So, your name was... right! #h0#, wasn't it? Not that I really need to memorize the name of every single person living in this city, though.
1.1: Wait, #p425# big sis is wondering when I'm going back home? Pfft! Man, she nags way too much! I can totally take care of myself, you know.
1.2: Well... I get that she's just worried about me. But #m10001000# is just way too boring, I couldn't stand it. Anyway, just tell her I'm doing perfectly fine here. Catch ya!

level.0: But you... your level is, like, way too low?
